name: shadowbench
description: Hand-labelled smart-home plans for testing plan checkers, with Shadow Home and an LLM judge as baselines.

scripts.bench: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const n=fs.readdirSync('plans').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).length;const a=fs.readdirSync('labels').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).map(f=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('labels/'+f,'utf8'))).filter(l=>l.approvedBy).length;console.log('ShadowBench: '+n+' plans, '+a+' approved labels. The runner arrives on Oct 20.')"
